# Next.js Public Platform

Load `react-best-practices` and current Next.js documentation.

Default to Server Components and small client islands. Keep authenticated shells separate from marketing. Avoid data-fetch waterfalls and unnecessary serialization. Treat route metadata, canonical URLs, robots, sitemap, and redirects as one registry-driven system. Test SSR, hydration, search-parameter boundaries, build output, accessibility, and preview runtime logs.
